newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra International bonds set at 15.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Astra International bonds set at 15.5 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Astra International five-year 400 billion rupiah straight bonds were priced at 15.5 percent, underwriters said on Monday.
They said the coupon was fixed for five years, and more than 10 underwriters had committed to participate.
One foreign brokerage underwriter said the issue seemed to be largely oversubscribed after an initial cautious response to the relatively modest pricing.
This was the second straight bonds from Astra International after the first five-year straight bonds due in February 1999.
